title: Context window · hancrafted
description: An interactive explanation of the context window: what fills an AI chat, how compaction works and how attention thins out, with every control to try.

slides.text: Context window What fills an AI chat's window, step by step, and how much attention each part gets: try every part and control.

Replay the chat The summer party chat at step 9, with its timeline. The window itself is tucked away until you ask for it. Read me slide-3 What it shows A chat with an AI assistant, played step by step. The Budget message is pinned, and only the conversation and its timeline are on screen. What to try Hover or drag the timeline to replay earlier steps. Switch on the context window with the Show chips. Press Escape to unpin the Budget message. What to notice Hovering only previews: the chat shows the earlier messages, and when you leave it returns to step 9. Presets (3/4) Page 3 of 4 The token grid The window alone, drawn as boxes of tokens, the way Claude Code lists it. Read me slide-6 What it shows Only the context window, in its Technical view: one box for every fixed number of tokens, grouped by category. What to try Hover a box to light it and its row. Press the code-brackets button in the window head to flip to the Simple bar and back. What to notice Technical names the real categories, such as system tools and skills, and the free space the AI keeps in reserve.
